scope: Local source and existing small receipt JSON only; no model/checkpoint, teacher, NPZ/ZIP body, MRI, GPU, API, HTTP, upload, fit or submission.
headline: The existing numerical factory, strict suffix/head loader and native392 reader are reusable. A baseline-preserving, dual-T4 standalone branch needs a new orchestrator and a trained-bundle identity contract; current predict_native is a single-GPU starting point, not a qualified submission path.

checkpoint.strict_keys: Frozen generic prefix digest plus exact blocks10/11 suffix, head keys/shapes/dtypes/finite values, config, source and label order. Load real checkpoints with weights_only=True and allow_artificial=False.

model.encoder: dinov2_vits14, 12 unchunked blocks, no registers, CLS384
model.head: FrozenFeatureHead hidden192, 83352 parameters, 12 outputs
model.inference: Same window_chunk16, ImageNet normalization, encoder autocast FP16 then stored-feature FP16->FP32, FP32 head under eval/inference_mode; no new TTA, crop, decoder or pooling.

pixels.training_equivalence: Reuse select_series, physical slice ordering, whole-native-series p1/p99, physical-aspect letterbox392, adjacent native +/-1 slices, up to48 centers, positions, planes and flags. Only train_series->test_series root mapping changes as existing predict_native does.

reuse.CSV: Existing read_prediction_ids/tensor_study/validate_submission preserve StudyInstanceUID string order and all12 TARGETS; test.csv reads IDs only, test_series.csv only5 structural fields. Report and targets are not requested.
reuse.baseline_preservation: Keep original14 ALL7 code cells byte exact. Seal the final baseline CSV on CPU after original fusion succeeds; compare its SHA before/after the independent branch; release original GPU model references and collect/empty CUDA cache before extra model load. p011 is a pattern for CPU seal and bounded delivery, not native392 decoder/model code to copy blindly.

concrete_gaps.name: Separate native392 decoding
concrete_gaps.evidence: Apex base uses384px FOV140/96-slot anatomical volume; native f005 uses physical-aspect full-FOV392 letterbox and3series x48 adjacent triplets. Resizing or slicing the existing Apex volume would not reconstruct training pixels.
concrete_gaps.action: Decode the test series independently using the already audited native reader, with bounded CPU workers and a separate temporary workspace.

concrete_gaps.name: Dual-GPU loading
concrete_gaps.evidence: load_frozen_encoder rejects any previously imported dinov2 module. Calling new_native_model twice in the same process fails. Existing predict_native does not expose a device argument and tensor_study defaults to cuda.
concrete_gaps.action: In a fresh DINO namespace, call new_native_model(...,device=cpu) once, strict apply once, then deepcopy the fully reconstructed CPU model and place one eval copy on each cuda:0/cuda:1. Alternatively separate fresh processes can each load once, but that is a separate orchestration design. No second relaxed loader or silent state-dict load.

concrete_gaps.name: CLS versus same-shape Regional identity
concrete_gaps.evidence: Native and Regional components share head/state shapes. Existing checkpoint make/load/apply have no representation/model-class field; source/config hashes identify current CLS producer only if authentic production provenance is separately bound. A tensor-key check alone cannot detect a mislabeled same-shape Regional artifact.
concrete_gaps.action: Use an external immutable trained-bundle manifest: exact CLS-only representation/schema, NativeTripletMIL class, producer CLI/source/config/run/checkpoint SHA, targets and approved weak-only selection audit. Reject missing/Regional/unknown identity before model construction; actual checkpoint claims must be cross-checked against the completed accepted run. Future Regional must use its distinct checkpoint schema, never this branch.

concrete_gaps.name: Unusable inputs
concrete_gaps.evidence: extract_pixel_study propagates a selected-series decoder error; no selected usable series/all mask0 is rejected by pixel validation and NativeTripletMIL. It differs from the author224 finite allmissing behavior.
concrete_gaps.action: Future proposal only: for a genuinely eligible study whose native input is validly determined to have zero usable windows, use its sealed p005 prediction as that UID's extra-branch surrogate, with an explicit reason/count/UID-hash receipt. This changes fusion mathematics, is not implemented or Kaggle-verified, and needs root review before adoption. Unexpected decoder/model/CUDA/schema/contract errors remain fatal; do not silently catch every exception or put zero probabilities into the extra branch.

concrete_gaps.name: Dependency and reader identity
concrete_gaps.evidence: Checkpoint source inventory pins8 rsna_knee modules but does not include bounded_feature_reader.py. Importing native_training_fast16 also imports runtime, checkpoints, metrics and runtime->model->torchvision; the8-file hash inventory alone is not a complete offline package.
concrete_gaps.action: Package the exact existing rsna_knee import closure or complete source package, explicit reader/orchestrator hashes, pinned generic DINO source tree, provenance and local weights. Run imports/hash/checkpoint metadata smoke in the actual Original Kaggle offline environment; do not add Internet installation.

bounded_transport_design.reuse_function: scripts/p010_shared_runtime.py:65 run_bounded_pipeline with all required explicit capacities, task_done/drain/cancel and per-study receipt contracts; source-bound wrapper specific to native extraction needed.
bounded_transport_design.consumer_grad_contract: torch.inference_mode is thread-local. Each consume(device,item) must enter its own inference_mode context before NativeTripletMIL/tensor_study/sigmoid; a context around the parent pipeline call does not cover its two new consumer threads. Keep model.eval() and explicit device placement for each model/payload.
bounded_transport_design.limitations: Bound excludes worker arrays, IPC serialization copies, decoded native series and file-backed percentile pages. Each selected series uses two native float32 memmaps plus256MiB disk reserve and8MiB copy chunks; that does not prove a constant RSS bound. Native header/series size and hidden study count still vary. Initializer failures must propagate by shared fatal flag/task result rather than Pool respawn or masked-zero substitution; do not assume watchdog coverage for OS-killed workers.

prior_resource_reference.input: Artificial full144 triplets, one study, existing generic model, both arms forward/backward, zero optimizer steps; no MRI or labels.
prior_resource_reference.interpretation: Artificial serialized freeze head343027B and last2 suffix/head14553417B guide bundle size. 4090 reserved memory and warmed forward time are not T4 measurements, real trained-checkpoint size, hidden completion bounds or accuracy evidence.

qualification_sequence: Complete accepted f005 frozen/last2 fold0 contrast first, then predefined fold1 controls; review weak missing-label BCE/AUC and source/run audit without gold selection or coefficient search. Selected real checkpoint is currently unknown.
Bind real checkpoint/config/CLI/source/provenance/CLS representation and approved weak/group/Gold audits to the new immutable private bundle; inspect state tensors only in that authorized later step.
Root separately uploads/pins the Input and runs CPU mount/import/hash smoke. No new public scores can be inferred from that smoke.

Independent Kaggle T4 branch: tiny artificial model forward/output contract then actual label-free64/256 cohort, including all144 windows, unchanged decoder pixels/masks,1study/GPU, two consumers, resources/cleanup/UID/CSV receipts. Single-GPU predict_native can serve as strict reference, with GPU float variation assessed rather than assumed deterministic.

Before serving, root reviews total baseline+extra wall time/RSS/temp disk/GPU peaks, explicit missing-input policy, complete native test UID coverage and coefficient plan. Actual64/256 engineering success does not prove hidden coverage or Public improvement.

preexisting_cache_state.scope: Reused root acceptance JSON only; no current archive array or full-index body reread. Index builder and real fitting are root-owned later/current operations, not performed here.

prototype_decision: No inference/serving prototype or new trainer was connected in this source-review task. Existing strict predict_native already provides the minimum standalone reference. Its unresolved trained-bundle identity, allmissing policy and T4 orchestration should be settled before a new real-checkpoint path is implemented; no fake artifact is presented as a trained or serving-qualified model.
